service: Pagbibigay ng iba't-ibang kaalaman at kasanayan para sa kahandaan sa kalamidad
officeDivision: Office of the City Mayor - Local Disaster Risk Reduction Management Division
whoMayAvail: Schools, companies, communities, barangays, non-government organizations, and other government agencies
description: The LDRRM Division provides free training, seminars, drills, and webinars on disaster preparedness, emergency response, and risk reduction to schools, organizations, barangays, and the public.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Request letter stating the type of training or drill requested, the schedule, and the intended participants

clientSteps.action: Submit a request letter stating the type of training or drill requested, the intended schedule, and the target participants. Submit at least 3 days before the planned activity.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Review the request letter; interview the client if necessary; obtain LDRRMO authorization; and conduct the requested seminar, training, drill, or webinar on the scheduled date.
clientSteps.personResponsible: LDRRMD Staff, LDRRMO I/II/III/IV, LDRRMD Administrative Staff
clientSteps.processing_time: 5+ minutes for intake and scheduling; duration depends on training type (see notes)

processingTime: Depends on the type of drill or training scheduled
notes: Schedule of Drills and Training: Orientation on Standard First Aid – 1 day; Standard First Aid – 3 days; Orientation on Basic Life Support – 1 day; Basic Life Support – 2 days; Valley Fault System Seminar – 3 hours; Disaster Risk Reduction & Management – 3 hours; Climate Change Adaptation – 3 hours; Earthquake Drill – 1 hour.

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Pagtugon sa mga aksidente, kagipitang medikal, at kalamidad sa mga karatig na barangay
officeDivision: Office of the City Mayor - Local Disaster Risk Reduction Management Division
whoMayAvail: Anyone requiring immediate medical attention or severely affected by accidents or disasters in nearby barangays
description: The CDRRM Quick Response Team responds to accidents, medical emergencies, and disasters occurring in nearby barangays of Calamba. Response is coordinated with the nearest Barangay Quick Response Team.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Call or text providing information about the incident location and nature
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Client, concerned citizen, 911, or other government agencies

clientSteps.action: Call or text to report the accident or emergency and provide information about the incident location and nature.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the call and dispatch responders (3 min); alert the nearest Barangay Quick Response Team (2 min); dispatch the CDRRM Quick Response Team to the scene (17 min).
clientSteps.personResponsible: Dispatcher / Radio Operator, Nurse, Responders, Ambulance Driver

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Pagtugon sa mga aksidente, kagipitang medikal, at kalamidad sa mga malalayong barangay
officeDivision: Office of the City Mayor - Local Disaster Risk Reduction Management Division
whoMayAvail: Anyone requiring immediate medical attention or severely affected by accidents or disasters in remote barangays
description: The CDRRM Quick Response Team responds to accidents, medical emergencies, and disasters occurring in remote barangays of Calamba. Response time is longer due to travel distance.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Call or text providing information about the incident location and nature
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Client, concerned citizen, 911, or other government agencies

clientSteps.action: Call or text to report the accident or emergency and provide information about the incident location and nature.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the call and gather incident information; alert the nearest Barangay Quick Response Team; dispatch the CDRRM Quick Response Team to the scene.
clientSteps.personResponsible: Dispatcher / Radio Operator, Nurse, Responders, Ambulance Driver

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Pagkaon o pagsundo ng pasyente mula sa kanilang bahay upang ihatid sa ospital
officeDivision: Office of the City Mayor - Local Disaster Risk Reduction Management Division
description: Ambulance transport service for Calamba residents who need to be brought from their home to a hospital. Request must be submitted at least three (3) days in advance via call, text, or letter.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Call, text, or letter requesting the transport service
Signed Patient Transport Request Form (submitted at least 3 days before the scheduled pickup)

clientSteps.action: Provide information about the patient's condition and sign the Patient Transport Request Form at least three (3) days before the scheduled pickup. Contact the CDRRM Office by call, text, or letter.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the call, text, or letter; verify patient details; obtain LDRRM Officer approval; and transport the patient to the hospital on the scheduled date.
clientSteps.personResponsible: Dispatcher / Radio Operator / Nurse, LDRRMO I/IV, Ambulance Driver, Responder
clientSteps.processing_time: 4 oras at 10 minuto (5 min intake + 5 min approval + 4 hours transport)

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Pagkaon o pagsundo ng pasyente mula sa ospital upang ihatid sa kanilang bahay
officeDivision: Office of the City Mayor - Local Disaster Risk Reduction Management Division
description: Ambulance transport service for Calamba residents being discharged from the hospital and needing to be brought home. Request must be submitted at least three (3) days in advance.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Call, text, or letter requesting the transport service
Signed Patient Transport Request Form (submitted at least 3 days before the scheduled discharge date)
Patient Discharge Form and official receipt of hospital payments

clientSteps.action: Provide information about the patient's condition and discharge details by signing the Patient Transport Request Form at least three (3) days before the scheduled discharge date.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the call, text, or letter; verify patient details; obtain LDRRM Officer approval; and transport the patient from the hospital to their home on the scheduled date.
clientSteps.personResponsible: Dispatcher / LDRRMD Staff, LDRRMO I/IV, Nurse, Ambulance Driver, Responder
clientSteps.processing_time: 5 oras at 10 minuto (5 min intake + 5 min approval + 5 hours transport)

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Paglipat ng pasyente mula sa isang ospital patungo sa ibang ospital
officeDivision: Office of the City Mayor - Local Disaster Risk Reduction Management Division
description: Ambulance service for transferring patients between hospitals when higher-level or specialized care is needed at another facility. Requires coordination from both the referring and receiving hospitals.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Call or text with coordination from both the referring and receiving hospitals

clientSteps.action: Provide information about the patient's condition and the intended transfer by signing the Patient Transport Request Form.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the call or text; obtain LDRRM Officer approval; coordinate with both hospitals.
clientSteps.personResponsible: Dispatcher / Radio Operator / Nurse, LDRRMO I/IV

clientSteps.action: Submit the coordination letter or Letter of Acceptance from the receiving hospital.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Transport the patient from the referring hospital to the receiving hospital.

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

officeDivision: Office of the City Mayor - Local Disaster Risk Reduction Management Division
whoMayAvail: Schools, companies, communities, non-government organizations, and other government agencies organizing events
description: Provision of a standby ambulance and CDRRM personnel during organized events, activities, or gatherings. Request must be submitted at least three (3) days before the event.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Request letter containing event details: name of organization, purpose, venue, date, and time

clientSteps.action: Submit a request letter containing event details at least three (3) days before the scheduled event.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Review the request letter; interview the client if necessary; obtain LDRRMO authorization; deploy the standby ambulance and personnel on the scheduled event date.
clientSteps.personResponsible: Nurse / LDRRMD Administrative Staff, LDRRMO I/III/IV, Dispatcher, Responder, Ambulance Driver
clientSteps.processing_time: 15 minuto for processing; deployment covers the duration of the event

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025
